Frontend critical path PASS: signup -> dashboard -> shop (3 tabs + 3x stress cycle) -> stripe canceled flow -> stripe success-polling dialog -> dashboard/leaderboard/profile. 0 console.error / 0 key warnings / 0 unstable-nested warnings (matches iter 8 baseline; Shop refactor preserves the prior fixes). Rarity gates verified visually: Kites 3/8/14/20, Skies 4/9/15/20. Equipped summary, header, tabs, polling dialog all visually identical to pre-refactor.

minor.issue: Public preview URL responses include 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' AND 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true' for EVERY origin (evil.example.com, attacker-suffix, etc.). The FastAPI CORS hardening in server.py is CORRECT and verified directly via localhost:8001 (evil origin -> no ACAO, legit origin -> exact echo, regex origin -> echoed, suffix-attack -> no ACAO). However the kubernetes ingress in front of port 8001 appears to overwrite/append wildcard CORS headers, partially defeating the CWE-942 fix when accessed via the public URL. Browsers reject ACAO:* + credentials:true so the actual frontend (same-origin) is unaffected, but a cross-origin attacker still sees permissive headers from the edge. Recommend: ask platform team to disable ingress-level CORS for /api/* OR set ingress to honor backend CORS only.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 9 CORS hardening + Shop refactor CLEAN. Key finding: the K8s ingress injects 'ACAO: *' + 'ACAC: true' on every public-URL response, defeating the FastAPI hardening when accessed via the public preview URL. The FastAPI middleware itself is correct (verified directly via localhost:8001). Backend CORS regression tests hit localhost:8001 explicitly via the LOCAL_API constant in test_kite_trivia.py — do NOT change them to hit the public URL or they will fail because of the ingress override. Shop refactor preserves all original behavior; the 7 new files under /app/frontend/src/pages/shop/ are pure presentational extractions. The 'Buy on level-locked item' toast branch is unreachable via UI at level 1 because locked rarity sections render only a placeholder, not individual locked cards — that branch is only exercisable for users at high enough level that some items in the section are gated above their level.
rca of the issue: No issues found in scope. Sole observation (out-of-scope, platform-level): K8s ingress overrides FastAPI CORS headers with permissive wildcard on the public URL. Mitigation: ask platform/devops team to disable ingress-level CORS injection for /api/* so the explicit allowlist FastAPI now enforces actually reaches cross-origin clients. No immediate user-facing risk because the frontend is same-origin and browsers reject ACAO:*+credentials:true on cross-origin requests.
